name: Christmas
_comment: Every url must extract as kind=recipe with an image (curl /api/recipe/extract?url=...&refresh=1). Optional yields/total_time_s override the extracted values (null hides them).

ui._comment: Everything the screensaver shows that is specific to this deck. Optional 'palette' ({bg: [top, mid, bottom], gold, cream, soft, accent} as #hex) recolours it; without one the built-in Christmas colours are used. effects: lights, snow, leaves. countdown: 'to' is MM-DD or a {month, weekday, nth} rule (weekday 1=Mon..7=Sun), 'many' takes {n}, 'days' are exact-date overrides, 'today' shows on the day itself, 'after' once it has passed.
ui.hint: Tap to wake — then ＋ to add it to My Recipes
